title: RocketEDA Engine v1 design contract
description: Generated standalone consumer schema compiled from the canonical Engine v1 bundle rooted at contracts/engine-v1.schema.json. Do not edit generated output.
x-owner: RocketEDA engine maintainer; user approves semantic freeze

x-invariants.runtime: Exactly one EngineRuntime owns projects, admission, scheduling, coalescing, evidence and events; adapters never construct an alternate Engine.
x-invariants.idempotency: Request ID binds canonical payload+trusted scope. Changed payload conflicts. Durable admitted/committed outcomes persist; retryable preadmission and awaiting_authorization are not terminal cached outcomes and can progress with the same ID. Trusted approval is associated to original scope/request/closure.
x-invariants.admission: Durably freeze accepted input closure before RunReceipt; dispatch immediately with capacity/dependencies. FIFO is burst/recovery durability, not polling or mandatory run_job.
x-invariants.recovery: No automatic solver/script reexecution after restart; report survivors; explicit resume/discard. Poisoned content key requires distinct quarantine override.
x-invariants.cas: Per-entity CAS on all touched/read dependency entities; global project revision advances once per design transaction, identifies snapshots and event position.
x-invariants.I28: Pin full consumed closure including canvas.toml, references, target, code, views, canonical ports/maps, bench target/interface/template inputs, layers/technology, PDK/models/decks, profiles/tools/versions, seeds and resolved config. Reproduce verdict/findings/measurements; native bytes may differ. Testbench interface staleness and exact authored/generator owner mappings are included.
x-invariants.bench_scope: At parent occurrence P, target path must equal P+[circuit sibling]+descendants. Stable-ID paths, explicit targets, no self/ancestor/unrelated scope, no duplicate DUT subtrees.
x-invariants.spice: Every circuit component has models.spice with explicit state/provenance; annotations/bench harnesses are not fabricated circuit components; missing or inapplicable models are never invented.
x-invariants.language: canvas.toml hdl.language selects authored HDL; changing it requires explicit source migration. Generated backend HDL does not count as a second authored dialect.
x-invariants.scripting: Full installed APIs in isolated workers; native scratch mutations publish through managed checkpoints. Explicit edits commit independently; exceptions do not undo earlier commits. Save/describe/query never execute code.
x-invariants.controls: Discovery/reads/watch/cancel remain responsive under heavy-job saturation; short editor writer lane does not wait for a solver. Accepted jobs never silently drop.
x-invariants.qualification: Declared task/tool registration is not installation, qualification or target readiness. Missing models/decks/language compilers produce typed reasons; process exit0 is not PASS.
x-invariants.references: Editable project source/view links may follow WorkingRef identity; external library/PDK/package references pin revisions. Run resolution freezes all to PinnedRef. LocalRef is edit-only and resolved before durable commit.
x-invariants.coalescing: Only in-flight tasks declared snapshot/artifacts-only coalesce. Hit attaches request identity without consuming a new job slot even at saturation. Shared-run cancel affects all attached callers. Edits and scripts never coalesce.
x-invariants.cancellation: Cancellation request is attributed and durable before worker termination; parent workflow cancel propagates unfinished descendants, child cancel does not cancel independent siblings, dependents become skipped with gate reason. One truthful terminal state.
x-invariants.bench_template: Creating a bench with no source creates a saved editable template plus explicit canonical port/harness bindings, resolved interface hash and template provenance. Regeneration creates a new source/diff; never overwrite edits. Placement selects scope, never infers DUT from x/y distance.
x-invariants.working_source: write_source saves new source revision; WorkingRef consumers resolve the saved head on the next snapshot. Pinned source consumers deliberately stay fixed and are shown as pinned in UI.
x-invariants.empty_null: Unknown optional field is absent; null appears only where schema permits, including unknown catalog port width and initial watch cursor. Empty collections are [], never null.
x-invariants.configuration: canvas.toml inline registered tool options are allowed; same option in inline and delegated config is an error. Default -> project -> explicit run override resolution is recorded with source provenance; required missing defaults fail.

x-compatibility.current_api: v0 generated docs and handlers remain current provider behavior until migration; v1 design frozen separately
x-compatibility.breaking_changes: Change version and migrate all consumers; no implicit field repurposing
x-compatibility.canvas: New file canvas.toml. Explicit atomic migration from canvas.cst; reject conflicting active copies, preserve old I28 snapshots unmodified.
x-compatibility.authority: This artifact owns v1 boundary shapes. Docstrings explain implementations and must conform; old ADR003 generation continues for v0 only.

edit_validation: Resolve local aliases; reject unknown/duplicate aliases before mutation.
Validate every entity against its registered kind and all referenced kinds/ownership.
Compute mutable touched+read dependency set including relationship owners; require exactly one current CAS precondition per existing dependency. Never gate unrelated changes on global revision.
Validate target scope, graph topology, technology/grid, pin/link consistency, source ownership and containment on tentative post-edit state.
Commit all files/entities/source bytes and one attributed revision/event group atomically, or commit none.
Return generated IDs, every affected revision, any stale interface/bench diagnostics and event cursor.

preset_expansion.spice_block: Create saved .spice subcircuit stub, canonical declared terminals/ordered map, default symbol, provided-source SPICE binding; empty body is draft and not simulation-ready. Initialize only missing slots; preserve explicitly supplied linked sources, views and interface declarations without generating duplicate stubs.
preset_expansion.gdsf_component: Create saved .py factory stub + layout_generator view with entry/profile; create default symbol from declarations; execute qualified generator explicitly to materialize ports/layout, never during query/edit. Initialize only missing slots; preserve explicitly supplied linked sources, views and interface declarations without generating duplicate stubs.
preset_expansion.hdl_component: Create saved source-set/top stub in canvas selected authoring HDL; generate symbol from declared/elaborated interface; mark compilation/mapping pending until qualified run. Initialize only missing slots; preserve explicitly supplied linked sources, views and interface declarations without generating duplicate stubs.
preset_expansion.testbench: Create .spice/.sv/.v/.vhd/.py source based on bench type and canvas dialect using existing materialized interface metadata. Generation executes no user code. Save stimulus/probes/assertion skeletons and explicit target-port bindings. Unknown interface creates a diagnostic, never invented DUT pins. Initialize only missing slots; preserve explicitly supplied linked sources, views and interface declarations without generating duplicate stubs.

x-semantics.source_edit: Saving invalid text is allowed; retain last good interface and mark dependent views/benches stale. Do not silently remove canonical pins or wires. A source change never executes code.
x-semantics.bench_containment: For B=P+[bench], primary/additional targets are P+[sibling]+descendants. Sibling is a direct circuit child of P; descendants are circuit instances. Reject self/ancestor/other scope/noncircuit targets. Selected DUT subtrees cannot overlap. Probe paths stay under an explicitly selected target.
x-semantics.bench_mutation: Rename keeps ID binding. Target move/delete/interface or canvas-language change marks binding stale/missing; runs refuse invalid closure. Template regeneration emits new source preview; explicit relink adopts it. Graphical drag never changes hierarchy.
x-semantics.parameter_interfaces: Canonical declaration port IDs remain stable. Qualified elaboration yields occurrence-specific widths/directions/bit maps. Queries only read materialized metadata and report unresolved until explicit generation.
x-semantics.working_and_pinned_refs: WorkingRef follows stable project asset at captured snapshot; PinnedRef deliberately stays immutable. External catalogs always bind exact revision. LocalRef appears only inside edit entity inputs and is fully resolved before commit.
x-semantics.layout_publication: Full GF objects are real worker-local objects. project.layout.edit(cell) / publish checkpoints materialize geometry+hierarchy+ports, CAS the declared owner, and commit through edit.publish_layout. Small project.layout drawing helpers issue immediate typed edits. Arbitrary native in-memory mutation is not magically durable.
x-semantics.run_selection: Resolve task/adapter/profile/options and unique view defaults, validate units and pins/models/bench scope, union engine prerequisite gates, freeze I28 closure durably, then acknowledge and dispatch. Artifact-only tasks never mutate source implicitly.
x-semantics.workflow_completion: Resolve required coverage plan from canvas/PDK/target; expand one button into attributed child task DAG. Independent stages may overlap. Missing/unsupported/skipped required checks block full completion even if GDS exists.
x-semantics.configuration: Tool options accept known inline fields or a contained file validated by the same pinned tool schema. Duplicate fields across inline/delegated input fail. Effective settings include defaults, project config and explicit run overrides with provenance. canvas.toml, contained refs and resolved values are I28 ingredients.
x-semantics.amaranth_testbench: In an Amaranth canvas, HDL testbench templates use qualified amaranth.sim Python source. Cocotb remains a separate bench type against qualified generated-Verilog simulator paths. No package availability is implied by the canvas enum.
x-semantics.tool_selection: Task providers are selectable drivers; tools lists include subordinate dependencies. A caller cannot select an SMT solver or meshing helper as the task driver. A task with no providers is orchestrated by the engine and has no tool override; its pinned plan/coupling defines child tools.
x-semantics.bench_analysis: Saved native SPICE stimulus/controls remain editable source. Resolve analysis knobs from qualified bench/canvas configuration and explicit typed run selection; diagnose conflicting source/config directives instead of guessing. Explicit run overrides generate a derived native deck without rewriting source. Unsupported native control semantics remain a managed script path, never a fabricated trusted result.

x-validation-boundary: JSON Schema validates observable shapes/conditional forms. Provider must also prove the relational, ownership, dimensional and scheduling semantics in x-semantics and docs/work/API-V1/execution-review.md; fixtures do not claim live provider conformance.

ComplexValue.description: Complex float64 pair; never magnitude-only or ambiguous two-element array. Ingest rejects nonfinite JSON numbers.

ChunkRef.description: Immutable bounded chunk. Offset/shape are element coordinates, not bytes; fetch validates hash, codec, dtype and shape. Arrow/NPY/JSON format is data, never executable codec source.

RealBuffer.description: Flattened C-order samples. Shape equals axis sizes; null requires quality metadata. int64 uses decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript.

IntegerBuffer.description: Flattened C-order samples. Shape equals axis sizes; null requires quality metadata. int64 uses decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript.

ComplexBuffer.description: Flattened C-order samples. Shape equals axis sizes; null requires quality metadata. int64 uses decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript.

BoolBuffer.description: Flattened C-order samples. Shape equals axis sizes; null requires quality metadata. int64 uses decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript.

ChunkedBuffer.description: Chunk coverage must exactly cover the logical shape with no unintended gaps/overlaps; a partial result explicitly declares missing portions.

DataAxis.description: Every axis has stable identity and explicit units. Coordinate order is stored, not guessed; values may be decimal-string integer ticks for exact large time coordinates.

DataCondition.description: PVT corner, temperature, voltage, sample seed/index, wavelength or parameter condition attached to the exact data slice.

CanonicalSignal.description: Canonical design locator; at least one port_id/net_id is required, resolved against the result snapshot.

BenchTarget.description: Resolved relative to bench parent occurrence. First ID is a sibling circuit instance; remaining IDs descend inside it. No self, parent, ancestor, unrelated scope or annotation.

TestbenchData.description: Creating without source generates a persisted editable template from placement, target interface and bench_type. Regeneration is explicit into a new source asset. Benches are harness objects excluded from manufactured circuit. Template provenance is retained for generated sources; target/interface changes mark binding stale and block execution. Production targets cannot overlap; harness wiring is explicit.

BenchProbe.description: Target index 0 is primary, 1..N are declared additional targets. Descendants resolve only within selected DUT subtree; probes never add duplicate DUT instances.

HarnessBinding.description: Explicit generated/editable harness terminal or signal to canonical target port binding, including extra DUTs; excluded from production netlist.

MetricConstraint.description: Metric and unit schemas are registered; unknown metrics fail loudly. Applies per stated target, otherwise project top.

ToolSetting.description: Optional project-relative configuration references validate against the pinned task/tool schema and enter I28. No environment interpolation.

hdl.description: One authored HDL dialect per canvas; omit the key when the canvas has no authored digital content (photonic-only). Generated backend Verilog and qualified imported macro model views are separate from authored HDL; Amaranth requires qualified frontend/profile. An empty block never means photonic: language stays required whenever hdl is present.

CanvasConfig.description: Parsed TOML canvas.toml. Geometry/source data stay in referenced project files. An absent hdl key means no authored digital content (photonic-only): digital-only tasks stay UNSUPPORTED with a clear reason, never implied. Reject conflicting legacy canvas.cst and canvas.toml; explicit migration is an attributed revisioned edit.

ToolSettings_librelane.description: Inline options and delegated configuration cannot set the same field; report duplicate_configuration, never guess precedence. Run overrides are explicit and frozen in resolved configuration.

ToolSettings_ngspice.description: Inline options and delegated configuration cannot set the same field; report duplicate_configuration, never guess precedence. Run overrides are explicit and frozen in resolved configuration.

ToolSettings_xyce.description: Inline options and delegated configuration cannot set the same field; report duplicate_configuration, never guess precedence. Run overrides are explicit and frozen in resolved configuration.

ToolSettings_yosys.description: Inline options and delegated configuration cannot set the same field; report duplicate_configuration, never guess precedence. Run overrides are explicit and frozen in resolved configuration.

ToolSettings_openroad.description: Inline options and delegated configuration cannot set the same field; report duplicate_configuration, never guess precedence. Run overrides are explicit and frozen in resolved configuration.

SourceView.description: format must resolve a registered schema/capability. Multiple source files are one source set; output generated HDL does not change authoring language.

Models.description: Every circuit component has the SPICE slot; availability is honest. Optical-only, abstract and unelaborated blocks need no invented electrical model.

ComponentData.description: Creation presets share one component identity. Exactly one authoring owner per view; generator and manual layout are explicit variants, never competing writers.

SourceData.description: Project-contained source bytes are saved through write_source, never executed by reading/cataloging.

OpaqueId.description: Opaque stable ID; never infer meaning, parse a path, or coerce to a number.

Quantity.description: Finite value and explicit unit; domain registry validates dimensions and canonical conversion.

Transform.description: View units and pinned grid are explicit in the owning view; engine reports snapping.

PinnedRef.description: Exact immutable reference. Required on resolved catalog/evidence/lock data. Project source design links may instead use WorkingRef and resolve under the run snapshot.

WorkingRef.description: Live project identity in editable design records. Source saves are visible to the next run; snapshot resolution freezes exact revisions under I28.

LocalRef.description: Edit-transaction-only reference to a newly created entity. Engine resolves ID and revision before commit. Never persisted or returned.

SpiceAnalysis.description: Operating point, DC, AC, transient, noise, transfer function, pole-zero, sensitivity, distortion and qualified Xyce harmonic balance. Backend/model/version readiness is per analysis.

SeriesDataset.description: DC/AC/transient, frequency/wavelength responses, sweeps and corners. Every signal shape follows the same ordered axes.

TableDataset.description: All columns have exactly row_count values; int64 is decimal string data, IDs remain strings.

MatrixDataset.description: Explicit coordinate axes allow heatmaps/slices, including complex optical S matrices and parameter sweeps. A one-dimensional spectrum stays series.

DataMarker.description: Structured violation geometry cross-probes exact authored/native layout and layer; source revision belongs to the result snapshot.

MarkerDataset.description: Zero violations means markers:[], not prose or invented markers.

DigitalTransition.description: Ordered event time in dataset time_unit; preserve HDL unknown/high-impedance/weak/uninitialized states. Wide ticks use decimal strings.

DigitalSignal.description: Transition values have exactly width characters; ordering and width are relational conformance rules.

FieldDataset.description: Defined post-MVP field data; schema validity is not evidence of an installed/qualified physics adapter.

TreeNodeValue.description: One named scalar attached to a tree node, such as worst slack in nanoseconds.

TreeNode.description: One flat hierarchy node. Roots have no parent_id; nesting is by reference, never by document depth.

TreeDataset.description: Stage and grouped-violation trees: flow stages, timing paths, violation groups. Flat nodes with stable IDs.

Precondition.description: Per-entity CAS including affected relationship owners, view manifests and read dependencies. Distinct entities do not conflict merely because global project revision advanced.

CreateChange.description: Client temporary keys resolve atomically to engine-issued IDs, including nested references in the change set.

ReplaceChange.description: Full typed replacement; kind and stable identity cannot change. Required existing-entity CAS is in preconditions.

DeleteChange.description: Default reject on dangling links. Explicit detach requires all affected entities and CAS preconditions.

ConnectChange.description: Maintains canonical net membership and visual connectivity atomically; geometry proximity alone is not connectivity.

GeometryChange.description: Technology-driven paint/erase/contact behavior; use pinned technology semantics, preserve material/source layers and derived output provenance.

WriteSourceChange.description: Writes generic editor text including HDL/SPICE/Python/docs. Save never executes source. Source reparse reports interface drift; it never silently deletes connected ports.

PublishLayoutChange.description: Publishes worker/native GF cell data into managed project state under CAS; validates hierarchy, technology, grid and port links.

AdoptChange.description: Explicitly promotes generated artifact to a versioned source/view, retaining provenance; no implicit promotion by a run.

ProjectLifecycleChange.description: Open/close affects runtime attachment only; fork/archive/restore/migrate has explicit source effects. Restore advances a new revision and never erases ledger history.

TemplateChange.description: Always emits a new source revision/file with preview/diff; relink explicitly. Existing edited code is never overwritten automatically.

EditParams.description: Atomic typed transaction. Existing-project edits require project_id; creating a project may omit it. One durable revision/event group per committed design transaction. No automatic merging.

ProjectData.description: location is resolved by engine-managed/explicitly linked project policy; no path can escape its granted root.

WatchParams.description: after:null establishes bootstrap snapshot/cursor atomically. Cursors are opaque, ordered per runtime stream and bound to filters/scope.

InputLock.description: I28: full transitive consumed source/model/PDK/technology/layer/pin-map/testbench/config/profile/tool closure. Inputs retained or fail loudly; outputs never substitute for missing source truth.

RunRecord.description: Execution state and electrical/design verdict are independent. No client can write a trusted verdict. No auto-reexecution on restart.

Target.description: Non-project targets require id; occurrence is a root-anchored array of instance IDs. Runs pin the resolved occurrence/dependency closure. A target id with repeated definition instances needs occurrence; never select an arbitrary first match.

ViewSelection.description: Explicit named view selection. Missing values use a unique declared default; ambiguous selection is an error.

depends_on.description: Additional caller dependencies only; engine unions mandatory prerequisite DAG. Cannot weaken hard input or check gates.

RunStart.description: options is constrained by task dispatch allOf below. Fresh bypasses in-flight coalescing, never request-id idempotency. Gate overrides require distinct trusted authorization; hard prerequisites are mandatory. All task outputs are run artifacts; adoption into project truth is explicit through edit. Managed scripts use their own commit checkpoints.

RunControl.description: Controls remain responsive under saturation. Resume applies only unfinished/interrupted runs; finished reruns are fresh starts.

ScriptOpen.description: Creates workspace history/context, executes no user code.

ScriptExecute.description: Exactly one of code/source. Uses ordinary durable run admission, same execution isolation and I28; never coalesce mutating scripts. Earlier explicit edits survive later exceptions.

ScriptReset.description: Revokes old worker authority/history generation; does not replay code.

RunReceipt.description: Durable acknowledgment; execution begins without a second start message. Every coalesced request ID persists. state records immutable admission state; query/watch provide current state, including an immediate completion.

AuthorizationPending.description: Existing trusted approval policy resolves this out of band; clients cannot forge actor/approval in request payloads. No run exists yet.

IpEntryUpstream.description: Provenance of a wrapped nested upstream checkout (entry_repo/): where it came from, which revision, under which license. Mandatory exactly when entry_repo/ is present.

IpEntryPort.description: One block port (symbol pin or cell terminal). Only the name is contracted today; domain nests standardize later without breaking this shape.

IpEntry.description: Catalogue entry identity plus adapter metadata. Top level is closed (unknown keys fail loudly) so future fields arrive through deliberate schema evolution; port nests stay open until their standard lands. name must equal the entry folder slug; version pins the entry revision a registry block resolves to.

ShapeData.description: Physical geometry belongs to a cell; it is not automatically a separate circuit component.

Locator.description: A bounded catalog/read source. Non-engine sources require id; PDK/library/package enumeration binds an immutable revision/profile in the response.

Filter.description: Fields/operators must be advertised by the selected catalog; executable predicates and arbitrary traversal are unsupported.

DescribeParams.description: Omitted subject means api. Returns method/task schemas, descriptions, examples, effects, requirements and contextual availability without executing project code.

CatalogItem.description: Catalog enumeration reports bounded descriptors and pinned provenance; never executes arbitrary module code or factories.

Page.description: Snapshot-consistent stable ordering; cursor binds query/filter/provider/snapshot. Empty result has items:[], has_more:false, cursor:null.

DescribeResult.description: schema carries the exact requested canonical schema fragment; upstream package help is version-scoped and labeled separately.

CatalogPort.description: Catalog interface ports include stable canonical identity; unresolved width is null with reason, ready operations require elaboration.

LogDescriptor.description: Verbose text belongs to the subscribed output terminal and raw artifact, not the normal plot/violations surface.

ResultProvenance.description: I28 exact consumed closure and upstream outputs; every dataset is tied to this immutable result revision.

ResultGap.description: Precise missing/partial/convergence metadata; not editorial copy for a default screen.

ResultBundle.description: Immutable, headless result data. Views bind dataset IDs; frontend owns plot/theme/docking. No HTML/JS/components, canned prose or renderer-specific payloads.

PortData.description: Declared stable interface port. Parameter/expression widths are resolved by a qualified elaborator, never arbitrary eval or query-time project execution.

Endpoint.description: Instance path relative to owning net/sheet parent. Canonical port identity plus explicit bit selection; no geometric contact inference or implicit parent traversal.

AnnotationData.description: Graphical-only: excluded from netlisting, ERC and fabricated circuit; plot links evidence without adding a device.

TaskPort.description: A declared task boundary port. Native formats include their codec/profile; downstream input must match kind/schema/format and exact snapshot.

TaskContract.description: Data-bearing task-to-task contract. Logs are evidence, never normal stage inputs.

TaskOutput.description: Published immutable output matches the declared output port; adoption as source is a separate edit.

TaskInvocation.description: Application-owned outbound port DTO. Adapter maps this to native input; transport/framework objects never cross the boundary.

describe.description: Inspect methods, tasks, tools, entity schemas, templates and requirements.

query.description: Read any registered project, PDK, library, hierarchy, package or evidence catalog.

http.semantics: read-only snapshot query; POST carries bounded structured predicates

edit.description: Commit atomic editor/project changes with typed entities and per-entity CAS.

run.description: Start workflows or individual tool tasks and control unfinished runs.

script.description: Execute full prepared Python/library APIs with managed project publication.

watch.description: Read or stream ordered events including edits, results and capacity transitions.

http.stream: SSE or bounded long-poll; same Event schema

workflow.asic.description: Run a pinned ASIC implementation and verification plan; completion requires every applicable configured check and complete evidence.

workflow.analog.description: Generate/netlist, simulate, characterize, verify physical views, and optionally compare extracted behavior according to the saved plan.

workflow.photonic.description: Run a saved photonic construction, circuit response, geometry verification, and qualified device-solver plan.

check.syntax.description: Parse and lint the selected source language and supported language subset.

check.connectivity.description: Check canonical circuit connectivity and interface mappings.

check.erc.description: Apply electrical rules to circuit participants and declared electrical semantics.

check.drc.description: Check physical geometry against the selected pinned technology rule deck.

check.lvs.description: Compare independently selected layout extraction and reference circuit netlists.

check.antenna.description: Check process antenna ratios and routing antenna properties.

check.view_sync.description: Compare selected source/native/extracted views using canonical identity and pin mappings.

check.layout_xor.description: Compare two layout stream-outs using geometric XOR.

check.formal.description: Prove, bound, or cover formal properties, preserving assumptions, bounds, solver status, and counterexamples.

check.equivalence.description: Compare golden and candidate implementations under explicit mapping and assumptions.

check.mutation.description: Evaluate test/property effectiveness against controlled source mutations.

simulate.spice.description: Run the explicitly selected SPICE analysis with compatible circuit/model views; every mode is qualified separately per backend and device model.

simulate.hdl.description: Compile/elaborate and simulate the canvas-selected HDL language using an HDL bench or qualified Python cocotb test source.

simulate.cosim.description: Run the selected analog/digital coupling contract. A sampled one-way handoff and a live feedback solver are distinct qualified coupling capabilities.

simulate.optical.description: Simulate a circuit using calibrated optical/mixed-domain compact models; advertise each model and analysis compatibility independently.

synthesize.hdl.description: Elaborate the canvas-selected HDL/frontend and synthesize a logic netlist, optionally mapping into a pinned standard-cell library.

implement.asic.description: Run a full qualified ASIC flow or a registered stage from a pinned compatible prior state.

implement.fpga.description: Perform synthesis/place-and-route and architecture-specific bitstream generation for an explicitly qualified FPGA device; programming is outside this task.

analyze.timing.description: Perform static timing with explicit clocks, constraints, libraries, corners and optional extracted RC; report missing constraints and coverage.

analyze.power.description: Estimate characterized digital power or calculate a qualified physical IR-drop study from declared activity and supplies.

analyze.measurements.description: Evaluate saved measurements, spectra/FFT, comparisons and plots against pinned result artifacts and measurement definitions.

extract.layout.description: Extract devices/circuit connectivity or parasitic RC from a selected physical view using a compatible technology/extraction deck.

characterize.circuit.description: Repeat supported simulations across explicit parameter/corner/statistical samples and evaluate a saved characterization specification.

simulate.em.description: Solve a saved physical field study with explicit geometry, materials, ports, boundaries, mesh and convergence settings; electromagnetic compliance requires its own modeled limits.

simulate.thermal.description: Solve a saved thermal study with explicit materials, power sources, boundaries and mesh; coupled electrothermal behavior requires a separately qualified study.

simulate.device.description: Solve declared semiconductor-device equations and physical boundary conditions in a saved qualified DEVSIM study.

generate.views.description: Generate selected component views from pinned sources/factories, producing candidate artifacts and canonical mappings; project adoption uses the shared revision-checked edit contract.

generate.netlist.description: Emit a circuit netlist for the selected schematic/component closure with explicit canonical-to-native terminal ordering.

export.design.description: Export a pinned design view or project bundle, retaining supported native properties and reporting any lossy conversion.

compile.model.description: Compile a pinned Verilog-A source closure into a compatible OSDI model artifact in the isolated worker.

librelane.description: Pinned ASIC flow distribution and registered flow/stage orchestrator.

yosys.description: RTL elaboration, synthesis, netlist transformation and serialization.

abc.description: Logic optimization/technology mapping and supported formal backend inside a pinned flow.

slang.description: Qualified SystemVerilog parsing, elaboration and diagnostics.

yosys_slang.description: Qualified Slang frontend integration for the pinned Yosys distribution.

openroad.description: Physical implementation, timing, power-grid and routing tasks through registered schemas.

opendb.description: OpenROAD physical database and registered geometry/netlist utility backend.

opensta.description: Static timing and supported characterized-power analysis.

magic.description: Technology-bound layout operations, DRC, extraction and native layout exchange.

klayout.description: Geometry/format processing, rule-deck DRC, qualified LVS and stream-out comparison.

ngspice.description: SPICE circuit solver with analysis/model/dialect-specific qualification.

xyce.description: Alternative circuit solver; its supported analyses and model dialect are qualified separately.

xschem.description: Native schematic import/export and netlisting; Rocket owns its graphical editor.

cace.description: Saved circuit characterization-plan orchestration and specification evaluation.

openvaf.description: Verilog-A-to-OSDI model compilation for a compatible target simulator.

icarus.description: Icarus Verilog compilation and event-driven simulation.

verilator.description: Qualified SystemVerilog lint, compiled simulation and supported coupling backend.

ghdl.description: VHDL analysis/simulation and separately qualified Yosys synthesis integration.

cocotb.description: Python testbench integration against a qualified installed HDL simulator.

sby.description: SymbiYosys property proof, bounded checking and cover orchestration.

mcy.description: Mutation-based evaluation of digital verification effectiveness.

z3.description: Pinned SMT solver used through a registered formal-engine combination.

boolector.description: Pinned SMT solver used through a registered formal-engine combination.

bitwuzla.description: Pinned SMT solver used through a registered formal-engine combination.

yices.description: Pinned SMT solver used through a registered formal-engine combination.

nextpnr.description: FPGA place-and-route for specifically qualified device/database targets.

icestorm.description: iCE40 device data and bitstream utilities where shipped and qualified.

trellis.description: ECP5 device data and bitstream utilities where shipped and qualified.

oxide.description: Nexus device data and bitstream utilities where shipped and qualified.

apicula.description: Gowin device data and bitstream utilities where shipped and qualified.

circulax.description: Qualified mixed-domain compact-model circuit analyses with a version-bound API.

gdsfactory.description: Full installed GDSFactory component, geometry, routing, ports and generation API inside managed workers.

kfactory.description: KLayout-backed component, geometry, port and connectivity library.

gplugins.description: Qualified solver integration subset; importing a plugin does not qualify its backend.

openems.description: Qualified local electromagnetic FDTD and RF/antenna studies.

csxcad.description: Geometry/material definition library associated with openEMS.

gmsh.description: Physical geometry and mesh generation under the selected study contract.

scikit_fem.description: Finite-element assembly library used by qualified modeling workflows.

scikit_rf.description: RF network/S-parameter processing and analysis library.

elmer_fem.description: Qualified finite-element thermal studies; coupling is study-specific.

gtkwave.description: Optional native waveform artifact viewer; inspection/launch is a frontend capability, not a computational run task.

pyspice.description: Python circuit/simulator convenience API; it is not an independent solver.

vlsir.description: Circuit/interchange data library used by qualified generation and exchange tasks.

vlsirtools.description: Circuit/interchange and simulator integration helpers in prepared workers.

numpy.description: Numerical array APIs in the prepared scripting/analysis profile.

scipy.description: Numerical/signal-analysis APIs in the prepared scripting/analysis profile.

pint.description: Unit-aware numerical helpers in prepared workers; the public API uses Quantity.

networkx.description: Graph-analysis helpers in prepared workers; canonical topology remains engine-owned.

jax.description: Pinned CPU numerical/autodifferentiation runtime used by qualified compact-model profiles.

amaranth.description: User-requested Python HDL frontend and native simulator; add, pin and qualify profile first. Generated Verilog may use other qualified downstream tools.

connectgraph.description: Engine-owned canonical connectivity, electrical-rule and identity-mapping operations.

workflow.asic.label: Build ASIC
workflow.asic.behavior: Resolve coverage plan from target+canvas+PDK. Execute prerequisite DAG, allow independent checks to overlap, block completion when required steps are unsupported/skipped/failed. Partial stop_after is not signoff.

workflow.analog.label: Verify analog circuit
workflow.analog.behavior: Use declared testbench/analysis plan and target specs; process-profile-required stages cannot be omitted by a client flag.

workflow.photonic.label: Verify photonic circuit
workflow.photonic.behavior: Honor required coverage profile; no claim that generic DRC/LVS or device physics applies to every PDK.

spice_block.description: Editable pure SPICE subcircuit and terminal interface; simulation-only by default, physical views attach explicitly.

gdsf_component.description: Project-owned Python factory with full installed GDSFactory, declared ports, materialized managed layout and generated symbol.

hdl_component.description: Digital component with source set/top/parameters, inherited canvas authoring language, elaborated canonical interface and implementation flow.

assembly.description: Hierarchical circuit composition with linked schematic and layout cell.

primitive.description: Qualified PDK or library device/cell reference with canonical interface and model availability.

testbench.description: Harness entity, not fabricated circuit component; SPICE/HDL/cocotb templates target legal sibling/descendant DUTs.
